venue.name: Amrita School of Engineering, Amritapuri Campus
venue.address: Amrita School of Engineering, Amrita University Main Rd, Amritapuri, Vallikkavu, Kollam, Kerala - 690525

items.information: ![](https://i.imgur.com/Upxb5EP.png) Why SILENCE? We will be trying our best to provide you all with an ambience of as much as silence and serenity as possible! Irrespective of the events... Yes, Including 3x3 and other NxN events which don't generally demand silence. :) We aim to experiment and see how much more efficient we'd all be in an ambience more favorable for cubing. With minimal spectator pressure. We plan have separate rooms for waiting and competing, where the competing area would only have the competitors for the round, scramblers, and judges in it. We urge all the competitors to strictly adhere to the rules and regulations to contribute to the mission of providing a serene ambience for all the fellow cubers. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your ID card as well. If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. Happy cubing!

items.information: This is not a regular speedsolving competition and it does not feature speedsolving events. The competition will instead feature blindfolded and fewest moves events. We do not recommend this competition for newer competitors, but all are welcome. ### Due to limited venue capacity, you may only bring **ONE** guest maximum. If you are over 18, we strongly encourage you bring none. Your registration **WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED IF YOU LIST 2 OR MORE GUESTS**. ### By signing up, you agree to contribute throughout the entirety of the competition due to the small size. This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). - Please review the [competitor information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasQuietChampionship2022#20842-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TexasQuietChampionship2022#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule.

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Open 2022 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic und delegiert von Niko Ronkainen. Diesmal findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Falls Ihr Gäste dabei habt, würden wir euch bei der Anmeldung im Kommentarfeld um die Namen eure Gäste bitten. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Open 2022 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Viktor Kalmar, Pranjal Khan, Florian Truckenthanner, Alexander Helbok, Sanio Kasumovic and delegated by Niko Ronkainen. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. If you bring any guests, please write their names in the comments of your registration.
